title: ⚡ ⚡ Iran Army Launches Three-Phase Offensive Against U.S. Bases in Kuwait and Bahrain
text:
⚡ ⚡ Iran Army Launches Three-Phase Offensive Against U.S. Bases in Kuwait and Bahrain"

"The Islamic Republic of Iran Army announced today it has executed three consecutive phases of "Operation Lightning," targeting U.S. military installations across Kuwait and Bahrain in response to what it describes as ongoing American aggression."

"⛓️ Missile Strike on HIMARS Systems"

"In the eighteenth phase of the operation, Iran's Army Ground Forces launched surface-to-surface missiles at U.S. HIMARS rocket systems stationed at Camp Arifjan, Kuwait. The military statement said the strike targeted the mobile rocket systems "capable of rapid repositioning," dealing damage to what Iran called "the enemy's offensive and defensive layers.""

"Drone Attacks on Three Kuwaiti Bases"

"Early this morning, the nineteenth phase saw destructive drone strikes on three major U.S. facilities in Kuwait:"

"- **Camp Arifjan**: Administrative buildings and direction-finding antennas were struck at what Iran describes as one of the largest U.S. troop deployment centers and command headquarters in Southwest Asia."

"- **Camp Udairi**: Drone attacks targeted a helicopter group parking area hosting Apache, Chinook, and Black Hawk helicopters of U.S. naval and air forces."

"- **Camp Ahmed Al-Jaber**: The accommodation facility for U.S. forces was struck, with Iran claiming this base plays "a pivotal role in the readiness and logistics of the U.S. aggressor army.""

"🚤 🚀  Naval Facility Targeted in Bahrain"

"In the twentieth phase, the army announced that "Arash kamikaze drones" targeted staging areas at Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain in multiple waves. The facility serves as a key hub for the U.S. Navy's Fifth Fleet and coordinates airstrikes and drone operations, according to the Iranian statement."

"⛔ Iran's Position:"

"The Islamic Republic of Iran Army announced that "regional security has been disrupted by the hostilities of U.S. terrorist forces," adding that its armed forces are "striving to restore security and stability to the region through their battle against the United States.""

"In a defiant closing statement, the army emphasized that "offensive operations will continue with full force until the enemy is deterred from its continued aggression against the country.""
